title: VERDA Hydrating Conditioner with Aloe, Oat and Rice Protein, 400 mL
altText: VERDA Hydrating Conditioner in a matte sage green 400 mL bottle with a white flip-top cap
bullets: Detangles without weigh-down: a hydrating conditioner for the step after shampoo, when wet hair needs to be smoothed out before rinsing and styling.
Two-minute routine: leave on for 2 minutes, then rinse, so conditioning fits easily into an everyday shower.
Made with aloe, oat and rice protein: a botanical formula with aloe leaf juice, oat kernel extract and hydrolyzed rice protein, alongside glycerin and panthenol.
How to use: apply to clean, wet hair. Leave 2 min. Rinse. The flip-top cap opens and closes easily with one hand in the shower.
For anyone who wants a straightforward conditioner that detangles without weigh-down. 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz. For external use only; avoid contact with eyes.
description: VERDA Hydrating Conditioner is a two-minute conditioner made with aloe, oat and rice protein. It detangles without weigh-down, so hair is easier to comb through after washing. The formula pairs aloe leaf juice and oat kernel extract with hydrolyzed rice protein, glycerin and panthenol in a creamy conditioner for the shower. Apply to clean, wet hair, leave on for 2 minutes, then rinse. The 400 mL / 13.5 fl oz bottle has a flip-top cap that is simple to open with wet hands. For external use only. Avoid contact with eyes; if contact occurs, rinse well with water. Ingredients: Aqua (Water), Cetearyl Alcohol, Glycerin, Behentrimonium Chloride, Cetyl Esters, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Panthenol, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Parfum (Fragrance).
